caseNameFull: Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. Kuntz
attorneys: Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Oberdorfer and Wayne G. Barnett for petitioner., Respondent pro se.

opinions.text:
Motion to dispense with printing response to petition for writ of certiorari granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

The Chief Justice is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted.
